meta.title: About us
meta.description: Nekor Partners is an owner-run placement firm for IT freelancers based in Frankfurt am Main.

hero.title: Placement without a layer in between
hero.lead: We founded Nekor because there is too often a layer between companies and freelancers that mainly finances itself.

story.title: Why we exist
story.paragraphOne: In the classic model the provider earns on every billed hour, for the entire duration of the project. For short assignments that is defensible; over twelve months it is expensive, and neither side usually knows how much margin sits in between.
story.paragraphTwo: We do it the other way round: we are paid once for what we actually do — finding the right person. After that, client and freelancer work together directly. That caps our business and forces us to be good at the placement itself.

founded.what: Nekor Partners founded in Frankfurt am Main, focused on direct placement.

network.what: Building a network of cloud, data and security specialists across the German-speaking market.

next.what: Contracting model, once contracts, status assessment, insurance and billing are fully in place.

direct.title: Direct rather than in between
direct.body: Where a direct engagement is possible, we recommend it — even when another model would earn us more.

consent.title: Nothing without release
consent.body: Profiles go out only with the freelancer's documented consent, for a named client and a named project.

transparency.title: Open numbers
transparency.body: Both sides know what we receive for the placement and when that fee falls due. No hidden mark-ups.

team.title: You talk to the founders
team.lead: Nekor is run by two founders who each handle the full process, from intake to signature. Nobody hands you off to a junior team after the first call.

sections.heading: Controller
sections.body: The controller for data processing on this website is Nekor Partners, [add address], email: hello@nekor-partners.com.

sections.heading: Contact form
sections.body: When you write to us through the form we process your name, email address, optionally your company and the content of your message in order to handle your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR. The data is deleted once the enquiry has been dealt with and no retention obligations apply.

sections.heading: Applications and freelance profiles
sections.body: If you send us a profile or an application, we process this data to assess possible assignments. It is passed on to client companies only with your prior consent, given for a specific named client (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw that consent at any time with effect for the future.
